items.title: Return CRS tax residency self-certification form
items.quote: Please complete the enclosed self-certification form and send it back to us by 29 October 2025.
items.computation: The bank itself states a fixed calendar deadline: 29 October 2025. This is a specific date given directly by a private company, not a statutory period requiring calculation from delivery; no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed since 29 October 2025 (Wednesday) is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW.

warnings: The letter cites a mismatch between the customer's German address and a Ghana-registered phone number as the reason for the request; the recipient should verify this request is genuine (e.g. by contacting the bank through official channels) before submitting any personal/tax information, since CRS self-certification requests are a known phishing vector.
